explanation: Ran ./eta/build/exclurad (model=3 EtaMAID, ivec=1 recoil proton, lepton=1 electron, bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0, vcut=0.166 GeV^2 -- standard CLAS12 eta settings) for a single kinematic point W=1.5576 GeV, Q2=0.5552 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.651724, phi*=72 deg. This point is above the eta production threshold on the proton (W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 1.4861 GeV) and within the tabulated EtaMAID grid range documented in the README (W 1.487-2.211 GeV, Q2 0.3-5.0 GeV^2, |cos theta*| <= 0.9), so it is physically accessible. The executable hardcodes its input filename to 'input.dat' (opens unit=5 as 'input.dat' rather than reading stdin as the README's '< input.dat' redirection example implies), so the run was done in eta/run_point/ with the crafted single-point input copied to input.dat. The run completed with exit code 0. Results were read from radtot.dat, whose columns are e1,W,Q2,cos(theta*),phi*,sig/sib,sib(unpolarized Born),as,asb,dd (per exclurad.F line 197-199). delta = sig/sib = radiative correction factor for the unpolarized cross section = 0.9159587896 (i.e. the radiatively corrected cross section is about 8.4% below the Born level at this point). sigma_born = sib (unpolarized Born differential cross section, code-internal units, consistent with the EtaMAID/microbarn convention used throughout exclurad.F) = 0.0063114262. Both values are reported exactly as printed by EXCLURAD, with no rounding.
